name: relations
title: Keys and foreign keys of the side tables
description: Primary and foreign keys of the CSV tables that have no column schema file of their own (the headers of most are defined in scripts/operations.py and scripts/build_references.py; the two command-relation tables list their fields here and in scripts/command_relations.py). Together with the foreignKeys of claims.schema.json and units.schema.json this is the complete list of references between tables; scripts/validate.py enforces every entry. `separator` marks a column that holds a list of keys; `alsoAllowed` names values accepted besides the referenced keys.

fields.name: relation_id
fields.description: Stable id of the relation, CR0001 onward; never reused or renumbered.

fields.name: subject_unit_id
fields.description: The subordinate unit (the unit whose command situation this is). Must exist in data/units.csv.

fields.name: higher_unit_id
fields.description: The higher unit (parent, attaching or controlling headquarters). Blank only for an explicit `unknown` placeholder (relationship unknown): no unit is named by any source and `note` says what is unknown.

fields.name: relationship
fields.description: Kind of relation (vocabulary relationship). Several relations of one subject may overlap when they are different kinds (for example organic or assigned plus attached or operational_control).

fields.name: valid_from
fields.description: First day the relation holds, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). With valid_from_basis claim_date it is only the first day a claim lists the relation.

fields.name: valid_from_latest
fields.description: Latest possible start when the source gives a range (valid_from is then the earliest possible start). Blank otherwise.

fields.name: valid_from_time
fields.description: Optional hour of the start on valid_from, HH:MM 24-hour (say in note which clock the source uses). Blank = hour not documented.

fields.name: valid_from_basis
fields.description: Where valid_from comes from (vocabulary relation_start_basis).

fields.name: valid_to
fields.description: Last day the relation holds, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Blank = no end recorded (see valid_to_basis and end_unknown). A missing end never means indefinitely valid.

fields.name: valid_to_earliest
fields.description: Earliest possible end when the true end lies in a range (valid_to is the latest possible end): for an inferred end the last claim date that lists the relation. Blank otherwise.

fields.name: valid_to_time
fields.description: Optional hour of the end on valid_to, HH:MM 24-hour. Blank = hour not documented.

fields.name: valid_to_basis
fields.description: Where valid_to comes from (vocabulary relation_end_basis); open_at_last_claim when valid_to is blank.

fields.name: end_unknown
fields.description: true when a temporary relation (anything but organic, assigned, unspecified_subordination or unknown) has no sourced end: valid_to is only inferred from the next claim, or blank. A standing relation without a sourced end is false (it ends when another one replaces it).

fields.name: change_undated
fields.description: true when the relation begins or ends a change of parent that no source dates: the change happened somewhere between valid_to_earliest of the outgoing relation and valid_from of the incoming one. Nothing is guessed inside that range.

fields.name: date_basis
fields.description: Where the evidence for the relation comes from, used for the `support` column of build/command_relations.csv (vocabulary relationship_date_basis); `inferred` when no claim names a basis.

fields.name: ordered_date
fields.description: Date the order that created the relation was issued, when it differs from valid_from (an order cannot follow the date it takes effect).

fields.name: status
fields.description: preferred, or alternate / disputed when the relation is known only from competing claims of a conflict group (such relations are not shown in build/command_relations.csv).

fields.name: note
fields.description: What the source says about the relation (the note of the claim that first listed it).

fields.name: relation_id
fields.description: The relation (data/command_relations.csv).

fields.name: claim_id
fields.description: The claim that lists the relation (data/claims/...): a claim of the subject unit (the relation is one of its own relationships), or, with role listed_by_higher_unit, a claim of the higher unit that lists the subject as a component.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Position of the link in the claim's list (1 = first); for a claim of the subject unit the list order of the former command_relationships cell. Links with role listed_by_higher_unit come after the claim's own relationships.

fields.name: role
fields.description: What the claim says about the relation (vocabulary relation_claim_role). For a claim of the subject unit it must agree with the stated_effective_from / stated_effective_to columns; listed_by_higher_unit marks a claim of the higher unit (see the vocabulary).

fields.name: stated_effective_from
fields.description: Start date the claim itself gave for the relation (blank if its entry had no effective_from).

fields.name: stated_effective_from_latest
fields.description: Latest possible start the claim gave.

fields.name: stated_effective_time
fields.description: Hour of the start the claim gave, HH:MM.

fields.name: stated_ordered_date
fields.description: Order date the claim gave.

fields.name: stated_effective_to
fields.description: Last day the claim gave for the relation.

fields.name: stated_effective_to_earliest
fields.description: Earliest possible end the claim gave.

fields.name: stated_effective_to_time
fields.description: Hour of the end the claim gave, HH:MM.

fields.name: stated_effective_to_basis
fields.description: Basis the claim named for the end date (vocabulary relationship_date_basis).

fields.name: stated_note
fields.description: Note the claim carried for this relation (blank if the claim's entry had none).

fields.name: stated_date_basis
fields.description: Basis the claim named for the dates (vocabulary relationship_date_basis).

fields.name: relation_id_a
fields.description: First relation (the lower relation_id).

fields.name: relation_id_b
fields.description: Second relation.

fields.name: overlap_from
fields.description: First day on which both relations hold.

fields.name: overlap_to
fields.description: Last day on which both hold; blank when both are still open.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Why they overlap (vocabulary relation_overlap_kind).

fields.name: explanation
fields.description: What the two relations say, and that the conflict is not resolved.

fields.name: relation_id
fields.description: The relation that who_controls.py sets aside for its subject (a preferred, non-organic relation of the master table).

fields.name: effect
fields.description: What the override does (vocabulary who_controls_override_effect).

fields.name: decided_by
fields.description: Who decided it.

fields.name: decided_on
fields.description: Date of the decision.

fields.name: old_value
fields.description: What who_controls answered before the override.

fields.name: new_value
fields.description: What who_controls answers with the override.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why (the decision and its ground).
